crossRefs.note: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

translations.web: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
translations.bsb: Otherwise, let these men state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin,
translations.kjv: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
translations.asv: Or else let these men themselves say what wrong-doing they found when I stood before the council,
